neighbours.label: the split-off subword token 'ender' after a stem (Cal|ender, F|ender, pret|ender, P|ender, of|ender), a spelling unit, not a meaning
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 spelling unit; strongest feeder of L4/N1871- (b-stub + -ated/-ender). Same stems with other endings stay silent (calendar 0.01, pretendant 0.04, Pendleton 0.06). Whole-word tokens that contain -ender (tender 0.60, gender 0.53, blender 0.55, lender 0.42) fire at mid strength, while render (0.13) and bartender (0.07) barely fire, so the claim is the split piece; whole-word -ender is a weaker partial branch. Chat was quiet; the label pick and sentences are the house's. The inverse solver crashed (toolchain JSON error) and was not used.
